title: latch storage with handles
text: latch storage with handles. These are nice... they are bit too small for what I had wanted them for... but I'll find another purpose for them.  The lids are not air tight (no gasket) but that is not what I had purchased them for.  The lid fits securely and the handle is so convenient.  They are a little bigger than an lunch pail...  I do a lot of crafts, so I will find something that fit in there!
